revision: Heuristic fixed constraint tightening; not tube MPC or a proved robust invariant set
scope: Fresh six-axis simulated UR5e joint targets under the existing distal-mass and bounded torque-disturbance family
prior_evidence: control-001 perturbed measured motion exceeded strict limits in 12/12 episodes; those results remain unchanged
completion: All six joints within 0.015 rad and speeds below 0.025 rad/s for 10 consecutive ticks; no physical bound breach or forbidden contact
perturbations: Every third perturbed case uses distal mass/inertia scale 0.85, then 1.15, then uniform [0.85,1.15]. Random disturbance phases and per-joint amplitude multipliers uniform [0.5,1.0] on [0.05,0.05,0.03,0.003,0.003,0.003] Nm sinusoidal disturbances. Nominal inverse dynamics remains unchanged.
observations: Exact simulator joint state; zero nominal acquisition delay. Stale, replay and expired dispatch are isolated fault tests, not sensor-noise validation.
measurement: Record all 10 physics substeps per control interval, including q, velocity before/after, native qacc, torque and contacts. Check maxima at every substep; report finite-difference and native acceleration maxima.
fallback: Rejected commands use the same tightened 0.85 rad/s2 nominal braking command; this is not a certified protective stop
acceptance: Nominal and perturbed completion each >=95%; zero measured physical bound violations or forbidden contacts in either group; all seven invalid-command fault tests rejected; Rust solve p99 <10 ms in each group. Every deadline rejection and unsuccessful episode remains in the evidence. No on-holdout tuning.
deadline: Rust checks elapsed monotonic time against 20 ms and combined observation age against 40 ms. Simulation runs faster than wall time; no hard-real-time service claim.
freeze: Complete development and tests, freeze all runtime/controller/audit sources, own Cargo.lock, exact binary and read-only v1 model fingerprints before evaluating. Repeated public-seed runs are regression, not new held-out evidence.
limitations: Same MuJoCo implementation for nominal inverse dynamics and plant; correlated model errors remain
Simplified discrete collision checks; no continuous swept volume guarantee
Research torque bridge, not an OEM driver
No learned perception, LLM, JEPA, ledger, Intel or RHEL integration
No payload sensor noise, compliance, backlash, cable loads or physical robot
Finite successful episodes do not establish formal robustness or safety certification
